Start from updated main (git switch main; git pull origin main) only if PR for feat/ca-later-reason-20261107 is merged; otherwise continue on that branch. New branch: feat/ca-nse-remaining-20261107. Runtime state after rebuild: blocked 140 (Split 33, Bonus 29, Other 78); NSE Issues 77.

TASK 1 - meeting wording by RULE, not by list (informational_closure.rs, with tests and negatives):
Close an OTHER row (no financial fields) when its whole purpose, after removing punctuation, is only meeting words: an optional ordinal, optional EXTRA/EXTRAORDINARY-like word, optional ANNUAL-like word, GENERAL, and a MEETING-like word, optionally followed by AGM/EGM and an existing revised note. "-like" means edit distance <= 2 to the real word and same first letter (catches Meting, Meetin, Meeeting, Meeing, Annaul, Annnual, Entra, Oirdinary, "Meetingagm"). Also close "Buy Back Of Share". Reject anything that contains a number, a currency (RS/RE/INR), or any financial word (DIV*, BONUS, BON, SPLIT, SPL, RIGHT, DEMERG*, AMALGAM*, MERGER, REDUCTION, CONSOLID*, DISTRIBUTION, INTEREST, REDEMPTION).

TASK 2 - meeting + money becomes DIVIDEND (parser, purpose_raw never rewritten, tests):
A meeting-like prefix followed by "/" or "-" and either a dividend-like word (Dividend, Divided, Dividen, Ivdend, Divdend, Dividnd; edit distance <= 2 to DIVIDEND) or "Re/Rs <amount> Per Share" is read as DIVIDEND with that cash amount. Never invent an amount.

TASK 3 - read-only diagnosis of the 7 NSE price mismatches (SBIN 2014-11-20 Split 10->1, BRITANNIA 2010-09-08 Split 10->2 and 2010-03-08 Bonus 1:1, JMFINANCIL 2008-09-08 Bonus 3:2 + Split 10->1, AJANTPHARM 2013-09-17 Bonus 1:2, NAVKARURB 2025-05-09 Split 2->1). For each, show prev close, ex open/close, the expected factor and the actual jump, and say if the local history already looks adjusted (no jump at the ex-date), if the date is off by one or more sessions, or if the ratio differs. Do NOT change any approval rule. Only if the evidence shows "history already adjusted" for a row, propose (do not implement) a safe rule and stop for user approval.

TASK 4 - read-only diagnosis of identity rows JSWSTEEL 2017-01-04, PCBL 2018-04-19, CGCL 2016-11-23, AVANTIFEED 2018-06-26: report exactly which check in split_isin_price_proof::evaluate (or the identity chain) fails, with the ISINs and owners involved. Do not loosen rules.

Never approve automatically. Keep backend rechecks, raw .eod immutability, advanced maintenance UI. CRLF line endings. Back up first with scripts/create-project-backup.ps1 (-Paths as separate array items).

VALIDATION serially: npm.cmd run typecheck:renderer; npx.cmd vitest run --dir src src/features/corporateActions (fail if " tmp/" appears); shared Cargo runner Preview then Run with the usual 7 filters and --jobs 2. Baseline: vitest 562, Rust 816. Report PASS/FAIL with counts.

DELIVERABLES: code + tests for Tasks 1-2; a report for Tasks 3-4 saved under tmp/fixtures/ca-diagnosis-20261107/; update HANDOFF.md top CA section, NEXT_THREAD_PROMPT_EOD_CHARTING_PLATFORM.md, ARCHITECTURE_CURRENT_EOD_CHARTING_PLATFORM.md; commit only your files, push the branch (never main). Say a portable rebuild is needed.

I’ll confirm the repo root and PR status, then inspect the CA parser, closure rules, identity proof, and current handoff. I’ll preserve other agents’ work, use only the pinned fixture for diagnosis, and back up the files before editing. The supplied AGENTS.md prohibits `git push`, so I can commit the branch but cannot push it under those instructions.

+    ("CGCL", "2016-11-23"), ("AVANTIFEED", "2018-06-26"),
+]
+
+
+def hashes():
+    return {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
